alt: An abstract digital render featuring a central floating cluster of 3D pink and red triangles, surrounded by a flat background pattern of scattered geometric shapes.
caption: An abstract 3D geometric composition of pink and red paper cutouts shaped like triangles and arrows floating against a.
description: This image displays a central, three-dimensional construction made of layered, geometric triangles in shades of pink and dark red. The sharp, angular forms appear to be made from textured paper or cardstock, creating a sense of depth. The background is a pale field scattered with a repeating pattern of similar small triangle shapes and dots, contributing to a digital abstract aesthetic.
